subject: ddl: run merge-temp-index step on DXF (#62971)
summary: Introduces a dedicated DXF step (`BackfillStepMergeTempIndex`) and executor pipeline to run the temp-index merge phase via the disttask framework, and updates the add-index reorg state machine to submit a separate “merge” task during `BackfillStateMerging` (including correct keyspace/table routing plus partition/global-index coverage).
